an8.15:1.3: (1) Non-recitation is the stain of the hymns.
an8.15:1.4: (2) The stain of houses is lack of upkeep.
an8.15:1.5: (3) The stain of beauty is laziness.
an8.15:1.6: (4) Heedlessness is the stain of a guard.
an8.15:1.9: (7) Bad unwholesome qualities are stains in this world and the next.
an8.15:1.10: (8) A stain graver than this is ignorance, the very worst of stains.
an8.15:1.11: These, bhikkhus, are the eight stains.”
an8.15:2.1: Non-recitation is the stain of the hymns;
an8.15:2.2: the stain of houses is lack of upkeep;
an8.15:2.3: the stain of beauty is laziness,
an8.15:2.4: heedlessness is the stain of a guard.
an8.15:3.4: in this world and the next.
an8.15:3.6: is ignorance, the worst of stains.
